question: What claim about transmission requires the teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters to have been told by an earth-mover to the beloved?
premises: There is a teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters.

It is addressed to the beloved.
inference: The teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters has been told by an earth-mover, O beloved one.
